rule.model_news.v1.name: Model + news
rule.model_news.v1.description: The signal model's probability with verified news counted at normal weight. Buys when the model gives at least 55% for a rise. This is the reference the other rule strategies are compared against.

rule.model_news_half.v1.name: Model + half news
rule.model_news_half.v1.description: Like the reference, but news counts half as much. Tests whether news is over-weighted.

rule.model_news_double.v1.name: Model + double news
rule.model_news_double.v1.description: Like the reference, but news counts twice as much. Tests whether news deserves more weight.

rule.model_news_confirmed.v1.name: Model + confirmed news only
rule.model_news_confirmed.v1.description: Like the reference, but only news confirmed by a filing or by two independent outlets counts; single-source stories are ignored. Tests whether unconfirmed news adds noise.

rule.model_news_high.v1.name: Model + major news only
rule.model_news_high.v1.description: Like the reference, but only news rated high materiality counts. Tests whether small news matters.

rule.model_news_global.v1.name: Model + news + global cues
rule.model_news_global.v1.description: Like the reference, plus the other markets' overnight moves, currencies, rates and commodities as model inputs. Tests whether global cues help (they showed no edge in the 15-year back-test).

rule.model_news_calm.v1.name: Model + news, calm markets only
rule.model_news_calm.v1.description: Like the reference, but makes no trades when the market regime is unstable or event-heavy. Tests whether sitting out turbulent days helps.

rule.model_news_strict.v1.name: Model + news, 60% bar
rule.model_news_strict.v1.description: Like the reference, but buys only when the probability of a rise is at least 60%. Fewer trades; tests whether being pickier pays.

base.always_up.v1.name: Always buy
base.always_up.v1.description: Buys every active company every day at every horizon. Any strategy worth having must beat it after costs.

base.momentum.v1.name: Follow yesterday
base.momentum.v1.description: Buys a company when its last session closed higher than the one before; predicts down otherwise.

base.model_only.v1.name: Model without news
base.model_only.v1.description: The signal model alone with news switched off (weight 0). Shows what news adds to the reference.

ai.news_results.sonnet.v1.name: AI news & results (Sonnet)
ai.news_results.sonnet.v1.description: A Sonnet trader that reads the company's news with its verification status, results digests, filings and events, without the model score. Decides on what happened to the company.

ai.pattern_mood.sonnet.v1.name: AI price pattern & mood (Sonnet)
ai.pattern_mood.sonnet.v1.description: A Sonnet trader that reads prices, indicators, the market regime, global cues and sector moves, without news or the model score. Decides on how the stock and the market behave.

ai.combined.sonnet.v1.name: AI combined (Sonnet)
ai.combined.sonnet.v1.description: A Sonnet trader that sees everything the other two see plus the signal model's score and explanation; it may move the model's probability by at most 10 points, with a reason.

ai.combined.opus.v1.name: AI combined (Opus)
ai.combined.opus.v1.description: The same as the combined Sonnet trader on the stronger Opus model (the existing forecaster, extended). Tests whether the stronger model helps.
